name: Moriya Memi
source:
Area: Chiba Prefecture

A girl who dresses up as a mascot known as "Peanutty", a talking peanut who can do amazing jumps, dance, makes jokes and also knows how to drink water from a certain place. With that, she works and cheers up children every day on stage.

Between each of the 30 minute shows Meni takes a break and gets out of the costume, something she hates because she sweats like a waterfall while inside the costume. However, for [url=/c70696]Shigeru[/url], the smell of sweat is more like a sweet fragrance for him...
